recognize_zh: 視野中央一個細胞核偏向一側、呈圓形深染，胞質豐富且呈特殊的洋紅色／粉紫色，邊緣像燭火般外展，這是火焰細胞（flame cell）——胞質含大量糖化免疫球蛋白的漿細胞。
features: Plasma cell with eccentric round dense nucleus
Abundant cytoplasm with intense magenta-pink (flaming) staining, fading to blue near the nucleus
Irregular, flared cytoplasmic outline resembling a candle flame
Background small round cells with dense nuclei and scattered neutrophils
Thin feathered-edge aspirate area with drying artifact and poorly preserved red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear, at a thin feathered edge with drying artifact, shows a plasma cell with an eccentric round dense nucleus and abundant cytoplasm that stains intensely magenta-pink with a flared, flame-like outline. The background contains neutrophils and small round cells with dense nuclei, which are difficult to characterize in this field. Findings are consistent with a flame cell (plasma cell with glycoprotein-rich cytoplasm); flame cells are classically associated with IgA myeloma but are not specific.

ddx.dx: Mott cell / Russell body plasma cell
ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple discrete round pale-blue or clear Russell bodies rather than diffuse magenta cytoplasm.
Reactive flame-like plasma cells are polytypic by kappa/lambda staining, whereas myeloma cells are clonal and increased.
Megakaryocytic cytoplasm is granular with platelet budding and lacks the eccentric plasma cell nucleus with perinuclear hof.
Gaucher cells have crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm with small nuclei and are much larger.
